author: NetworkChuck
description:
Join me for Fall into CCNA, starting September 14: https://ntck-ac.co/FIC

Getting my CCNA changed my life. It opened doors I couldn't get through before, and I still think it's one of the best places to start your IT career. AI can write a switch configuration, but you still need to understand what those commands will do to your network. If you've been putting off your CCNA, I want to help you get started this fall.

In this video you'll learn why the Cisco CCNA still matters, what networking skills it teaches you, how AI is changing a network engineer's job, and why the upcoming CCNA refresh is worth paying attention to. Whether you're trying to land your first IT job or you've started studying and lost momentum, I'll walk you through why I'm encouraging you to start now.

title: You Need to Get Your CCNA Right Now!!
